comments.note: The 9 active_pipeline_stages tests in work-package.test.ts validate the WP detail response, but none explicitly reads the root index summary (via listWorkPackages or getProjectStatus) to assert the field made it into the summary entry. AC#1 and AC#2 are satisfied by construction (same resolvedActiveStages variable assigned to both wpDetail and wpSummary), but a regression test that reads the root index summary and asserts active_pipeline_stages would close this gap.

Edge case: when active_pipeline_stages is omitted, resolvedActiveStages defaults to [...DEFAULT_PIPELINE_STAGES] (a 4-element non-empty array), so summary entries always carry an explicit non-null value at creation. The nullable().optional() schema allows legacy summaries to remain undefined without parse errors, confirming backward compatibility.
